title: What If Earth's Gravity Doubled?
yt_title: What If Earth's Gravity Doubled Overnight? #shorts
description: What would happen if Earth's gravity suddenly doubled? From collapsing buildings to dense atmospheres, explore this terrifying parallel reality.

scenes.say: What if Earth's gravity suddenly doubled overnight? Every single object on the planet would instantly weigh twice as much.
head: WHAT IF GRAVITY
*DOUBLED*

scenes.say: Right away, human bodies would crush under their own weight. Simple walking would become nearly impossible for almost everyone.
head: CRUSHING
*HUMAN WEIGHT*
scenes.label: 2X GRAVITY

scenes.say: Trees and massive skyscrapers could collapse instantly, unable to hold their new immense weight. Structural failure would sweep cities worldwide.
head: BUILDINGS
*COLLAPSING*
scenes.label: structural stability

scenes.say: Air pressure near the surface would double. The dense atmosphere would trap extreme heat, triggering rapid climate collapse.
head: ATMOSPHERIC
*PRESSURE*
scenes.label: surface pressure

scenes.say: Ocean tides would compress violently, flooding low coastlines before settling into hyper-dense seas. Marine life would face crushing water pressure.
head: DENSE
*OCEANS*
scenes.label: sea level

scenes.say: Flying birds and commercial airplanes would fall from the sky. Wings could no longer generate enough lift to overcome gravity.
head: FALLING FROM
*THE SKY*

scenes.say: Over millions of years, life on a heavy Earth would adapt. New animals would become squat, thick-boned, and move close to the ground.
head: EVOLUTIONARY
*ADAPTATION*
scenes.label: body structure

scenes.say: Here is the crazy part. Earth's molten core is already under three million times more pressure than the surface right now.
scenes.sublabel: Earth's core is already super compressed

scenes.say: Imagining strange new worlds isn't just a thought experiment. Welcome to Parallel Earth.
head: NOT JUST
*A WHAT IF*

scenes.say: Could you survive on a double-gravity world? Follow for more scenarios.
head: WOULD YOU
SURVIVE THIS
*WORLD?*
